title: Victorian locality and postcode lookup data
publisher: State of Victoria, Department of Transport and Planning

query.where: state='VIC' AND postcode IS NOT NULL

transformations: Selected distinct locality and postcode pairs for state VIC
Excluded NOT NAMED locality entries and missing or invalid four digit postcodes
Removed duplicates and title cased display names
limitations: Derived from property addresses; not Australia Post delivery validation. No street addresses or coordinates included. No completeness guarantee.
